{"model":"gpt-5.4-mini","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"## Tool Use

Use the provided tool `extracted_data` to extract correct and accurate structured data from the input.

Tool purpose: Function call based on user instructions.

Call the tool with the best supported arguments for the requested extraction."},{"role":"user","content":"You're an organizer responsible for only giving the skeleton (not the full content) for answering the question.
Provide the skeleton in a list of points (numbered 1., 2., 3., etc.) to answer the question.
Instead of writing a full sentence, each skeleton point should be very short with only 3-5 words.
Generally, the skeleton should have 3-10 points.

Now, please provide the skeleton for the following question.

<question>
Compose an engaging travel blog post about a recent trip to Hawaii, highlighting cultural experiences and must-see attractions.
</question>

Skeleton:"}],"max_completion_tokens":1024,"tools":[{"type":"function","function":{"name":"extracted_data","description":"Function call based on user instructions.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"points":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","description":"Correctly extract items of type: Point","properties":{"index":{"type":"integer"},"description":{"type":"string"}},"required":["index","description"],"additionalProperties":false}}},"required":["points"],"additionalProperties":false}}}],"tool_choice":{"type":"function","function":{"name":"extracted_data"}}}
